purpose: Generic previous-spells page shared by the no-stay Grimoire brochures (first used by Logout-Spells-Vietnam.pdf). Nothing on it names a specific spell, host or workshop.
photoMethod: Original founder-supplied photographs of previous Logout Spells groups, copied from img/content-memories (attachments 1-8 of the Content Spell request) and img/content-real (the Content Spell's real photo set), resized to at most 1400 px wide with high-quality JPEG encoding only. Full image proportions are retained; no faces, scenes or details are regenerated.
reviewMethod: Excerpts are contiguous passages from the visible message transcriptions recorded in img/content-memories/sources.json (attachments 9-14 of the Content Spell request), with punctuation and initial capitalization normalized only. Passages that name a host or a workshop are not used. Unnamed messages are attributed only to the group.
wordsSubtitle: MESSAGES FROM PREVIOUS LOGOUT SPELLS GROUPS
